findings.what: The book colour-codes the amine nitrogen in the two basicity-order lines in magenta -- 'NH' in (C2H5)2NH, 'N' in (C2H5)3N, 'NH2' in C2H5NH2, and likewise 'NH' in (CH3)2NH, 'NH2' in CH3NH2 and 'N' in (CH3)3N. The render sets both lines entirely in black, losing the cue that marks the basic nitrogen in each species.
findings.where: the two displayed basicity-order lines, just above the '(b) Arylamines versus ammonia' heading

findings.what: Both resonance figures are placed as reduced bitmap panels inside a thin ruled box and set flush left in the text column; the book prints them unframed and centred, roughly twice this size. Content is intact in both, but the label letters (I-V, and I/II on the anilinium pair) and the NH2 subscripts are noticeably smaller than the book's.
findings.where: the five-structure aniline resonance figure and the two-structure anilinium figure, middle of the page

note: Compared block by block. Both resonance figures were checked structure by structure at magnification: the aniline figure has all five structures with the correct curved arrows, the + charge on N in II-IV, the ring minus charge on II (ortho), III (para) and IV (ortho), the magenta NH2 groups, the four double-headed arrows, and the labels I, II, III, IV, V. The anilinium figure has both Kekule structures with their alternating double bonds, the + on both NH3 groups, the double-headed arrow and the labels I and II. Nothing is clipped at any panel edge. All running text is present and complete, including the final sentence listing -OCH3, -CH3, -NO2, -SO3H, -COOH and -X; the '(b) Arylamines versus ammonia' heading keeps its bold italic. The page number 269 and the 'Amines' running foot are present. The blank lower quarter is the page ending early after reflow, not lost content.
